rows.question: What is Form HR-15?
rows.answer: Form HR-15 is a document used by employees to complete before the final settlement is processed, signed by IT, Finance, and their Line Manager. (KA-POL-01, clause 6.5)

rows.question: What is Form COC-02 used for?
rows.answer: Form COC-02 is used to declare any actual or potential conflict of interest, including outside employment or a financial interest in a supplier or client, within fifteen (15) days of it arising (KA-POL-03, clause 2.1).

rows.question: Which form do I need to get USB access on my laptop?
rows.answer: You need to submit Form IT-SEC-2 (Removable Media Exception) to request USB access on your laptop, which must be approved by the Information Security Officer. (KA-POL-04, cl. 4.2)

rows.question: A close relative of mine passed away. How many days off can I take?
rows.answer: You may take three (3) days of paid bereavement leave on the death of an immediate family member (spouse, child, parent or sibling), and one (1) day on the death of a grandparent, (KA-POL-02, clause 7.1).

rows.question: What happens if I keep coming in late?
rows.answer: If you keep coming in late, it will be considered minor misconduct and may result in up to three (3) late arrivals in a calendar month, after which further instances may lead to more severe disciplinary action, (KA-POL-03, clause 5.1).

rows.question: Can I keep client files on my personal phone?
rows.answer: Client data must never be stored on personal devices (KA-POL-04, cl. 4.1).

rows.question: Can I do my work from a cafe using their Wi-Fi?
rows.answer: Yes, you can use the cafe's Wi-Fi, but only if you are connected to the company's VPN. (KA-POL-04, clause 6.2)

rows.question: How many failed login attempts lock an account?
rows.answer: Five (5) failed login attempts lock an account, and to unlock an account, a ticket must be raised with the IT helpdesk (KA-POL-04, clause 3.4).

rows.question: How long does a written warning stay valid?
rows.answer: A written warning is valid for twelve (12) months, (KA-POL-03, clause 6.2).

rows.question: What is the hotel limit per night in London?

rows.question: How long is maternity leave?

rows.question: Can I take annual leave while on probation?
rows.answer: Employees on probation are not entitled to annual leave, but with Line Manager approval, they may take up to two (2) days of unpaid leave during probation (KA-POL-02, clause 3.2).

rows.question: Can I fly business class on an international trip?
rows.answer: Business class is allowed only on flights longer than eight (8) hours, and only for employees at Grade 7 or above. (KA-POL-05, clause 3.1)

rows.question: Will the company reimburse a parking fine from a business trip?
rows.answer: The company will not reimburse traffic and parking fines. (KA-POL-05, clause 8.1)

rows.question: Can unused sick leave be paid out?
rows.answer: Unused sick leave cannot be paid out, as it cannot be carried forward or encashed (KA-POL-02, clause 4.3).

rows.question: Can I combine casual leave with annual leave?
rows.answer: No, casual leave cannot be combined with annual leave (KA-POL-02, clause 5.2).
